notes.title: 📣 Medievaly: Battle Simulator is NOW Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="oJEo637MNyg;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
🏰 [b]Medievaly: Battle Simulator is OUT NOW![/b] 🐔⚔️[/h3][p]Raise your banners and ready up your troops — [b]Medievaly: Battle Simulator[/b] has officially launched! Dive into a colorful, medieval-style battle simulator where strategy meets chaotic warfare. Build your army, destroy enemy castles, and [b]lead your troops to glory in vibrant battlefields[/b]!
[/p][h3]💥 [b]Castle-Slaying Strategy, Real-Time Chaos![/b][/h3][p][b]Dive into the campaign[/b] - Take command where you’ll deploy knights, archers, and siege machines to crush enemy strongholds. Every move counts. Think fast, build smart, and [b]watch your strategy unfold in gloriously unpredictable battles[/b].
[/p][h3]🧱 [b]Three Game Modes, Infinite Fun![/b][/h3][p]• [b]Castle Siege[/b] – Tear down the enemy’s walls and win the war.
• [b]Time Survival[/b] – Outlast waves of enemies ‘til help arrives.
• [b]Kill Count[/b] – First to 100 kills earns eternal glory.
[/p][p]Craft your own war stories in [b]Sandbox Mode[/b], with custom rules and terrains!
[/p][h3]🔔 [b]Join the Kingdom![/b][/h3][p]We’re beyond excited to finally launch, and we’d love for you to be part of our growing community:
[/p][p]💬[url="https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK"] Join our Discord[/url] to chat, share battle replays, and help shape the future of the game.
🐦 [url="https://twitter.com/Steelkrill"]Follow us on Twitter [/url]for updates, memes, and sneak peeks at what’s next.
⭐ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"]Leave a honest review on Steam[/url] - your honest feedback means [i]everything[/i] to us in order to improve
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][b]See you on the battlefield, commanders![/b]
- Steelkrill Studio[/p]

notes.title: We have some exciting news… Medievaly: Battle Simulator release date is here!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="ZdkKUiw2mS0;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]📣 Big News - We’re thrilled to announce that Medievaly: Battle Simulator will officially launch on [b]July 16th, 2025![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Get ready for an epic blend of real-time strategy and battle simulation where you'll command your troops to attack enemy castles, defend your own, and protect your farmers to gather gold. Build sieges, outsmart enemy tactics, and lead your army to victory across a variety of vibrant, beautifully colorful landscapes.[/p][p][/p][h3]⚔️ [b]Real-Time Strategy Meets Simulated Battles:[/b][/h3][p]Deploy troops with precision, defend your stronghold, and outsmart your enemies using real-time tactics. Every unit placement and decision matters—use your mind to dominate the battlefield! Set up defenses, expand infrastructure, then send out your men-at-arms to valiantly die under your banner in unpredictable, occasionally chaotic battles.[/p][p][/p][h3]🧱 [b]Sandbox Mode with Custom Rules[/b][/h3][p]Create your own battles with full control! Choose from 3 game modes:[/p][p][i]• Castle Siege – Destroy the enemy's castle.[/i][/p][p][i]• Time Survival – Hold out until reinforcements arrive.[/i][/p][p][i]• Kill Count – First to eliminate 100 troops wins.[/i][/p][p]Select your terrain and craft your own war scenarios![/p][p][/p][h3]🎨 [b]A Colorful Blend of Strategy and Simulation[/b][/h3][p]Experience a vibrant, visually rich world where real-time strategy meets dynamic battle simulation. Watch your tactics unfold in stunning, stylized environments.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔊 [b]Prepare for battle — Join us at launch[/b][/h3][p]Don't forget to wishlist the game on steam [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"]here [/url]and join our small, but strong community over on discord [url="https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK"]here[/url]. You can also follow us on Twitter [url="https://twitter.com/Steelkrill"]here[/url]. We are beyond excited to show you what we have crafted. [/p][p][/p][p]See you at launch day![/p][p]- Steelkrill Studio[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472300/Medievaly_Battle_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
